description: This Java source file defines the ToyVpnClient class, which manages the user interface and preferences for a Toy VPN client app on Android. It handles user input for VPN server settings, proxy configurations, and package selections, and initiates or disconnects the VPN service accordingly.
external_files: R (resources like R.id.* and R.string.* references)

classes.name: ToyVpnClient
classes.description: Main activity class managing VPN client configuration UI and initiating VPN connections.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout, reads stored preferences, and sets up button click listeners for connect/disconnect actions.

methods.name: checkProxyConfigs
methods.description: Validates that proxy hostname and port are either both filled or both empty.

methods.name: checkPackages
methods.description: Checks whether user-specified packages are installed on the device.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the VPN preparation activity, starting the VPN service if authorization is granted.

methods.name: getServiceIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to start or control the ToyVpnService.
